findings.note: Cleveland starter Parker Messick has a 5.40 ERA, 1.80 WHIP and 6 walks in 6.2 postseason innings, facing Freddy Peralta (1.93 ERA). ESPN lists the total at 7, so 6.5 is half a run under it. The game is at Tropicana Field, so weather shouldn't matter.

Game 1 ended 7-3 (10 runs), with Cleveland scoring seven in the last four innings. CBS says Cleveland's pitching was compromised after a five-game ALDS. On the other side, Tampa's staff allowed only five runs in 27 innings against the Yankees.
CBS links an article headlined 'Offense at historic low in MLB playoffs,' which points to low scoring league-wide this postseason. It's general context and isn't specific to this game.
